items.question: Will FIDO publish AP2 as a standard, and when?
items.context: FIDO gave no deliverable or date, its drafts are member-only, and the GitHub repository has not changed since 2026-04-29.

items.question: How does a user withdraw an open mandate before exp?
items.context: v0.2 has no revocation; ERC-8226 shows an on-chain revoke and freeze for comparison.

items.question: Who keeps state for payment.budget and payment.agent_recurrence?
items.context: Both need history of earlier presentations, and the specification does not assign that role; Verifiable Intent calls such constraints network-enforced.

items.question: How should a2a-x402 embed x402 in AP2 v0.2?
items.context: The documented Embedded Flow targets v0.1 CartMandate and PaymentMandate; no v0.2 mapping exists in either specification.

items.question: Can the context before signing be protected?
items.context: Research shows valid signatures do not prove intent when listings or tool results steer the agent; proposals bind credential lookups and cart lines to the session.

items.question: Will verifiers adopt consume-once semantics?
items.context: Runtime replay across retries is not covered; one paper proposes time-bound nonces and an issue reports that the samples never consume accepted mandates.

items.question: Which signature rule applies to the Checkout JWT?
items.context: The specification and the security considerations disagree on deterministic signatures; issue 268 is open and deferred to FIDO.

items.question: Will AP2 and Verifiable Intent converge on one set of key names?
items.context: Same vct values, different constraint prefixes, and Verifiable Intent renamed its keys on main without a version bump.

items.question: Will networks give mandate-backed transactions different liability?
items.context: AP2 leaves liability to the networks, and no network rule specific to agents was found.
